name: io.github.subzeroid/lamatok-mcp
title: LamaTok
description: TikTok data via LamaTok: profiles, videos, comments, followers, hashtags, search, downloads.

environmentVariables.name: LAMATOK_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LamaTok access key — get one at https://lamatok.com (100 free requests on signup)

environmentVariables.name: LAMATOK_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: core (default): 23 curated tools, one per task. all: every endpoint.
